Checked the failed_jobs table and found 1204 failed jobs with 47 malformed rows. I will proceed to investigate the root cause of these failures and start addressing the backlog.

Next, I will look into the pgbouncer connection pool exhaustion issue. Restarting pgbouncer in the prod namespace will clear the pool immediately, as mentioned. I will do this with your approval, P09.

Call `svc_restart` with the namespace and service name.
